faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What does residential interior design in Pitampura include?

Kitchens, wardrobes, bathrooms, ceilings, lighting, flooring, furniture and décor for builder floors, apartments and independent homes.

Can you redesign just the kitchen?

Yes. We design kitchens on their own and make sure the new kitchen matches the rest of the home.

How do I start a home interior project with you?

Book a meeting at our Netaji Subhash Place office or call us. We then visit the site, understand your needs and share a proposal.

Why plan residential interior design before buying furniture?

A plan makes sure furniture fits the rooms, matches the style and leaves enough space to move around.
